description_en: Queries the response status code statistics information for website services
description_zh: 查询网站业务的响应状态码统计信息
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo describe-domain-status-code-list --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --start-time 1582992000 --end-time 1583683200 --interval 1000 --domain www.example.com --query-type upstream --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomainStatusCodeList

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs in Resource Management. By default, this parameter is empty, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

For more information about resource groups, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
The value must be on the exact minute
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间。使用时间戳格式，单位：秒。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
The value must be on the exact minute
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间。使用时间戳格式，单位：秒。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The time interval between consecutive data entries returned. Unit: seconds. This parameter specifies how frequently a query result is returned
parameters.help_zh: 返回数据的步长，单位为秒，即每隔多少秒返回一个查询结果
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website service.

You can invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html to query the domain names of all website services that are added to Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有已接入DDoS高防防护的网站业务的域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The source of the query data. Valid values:
gf: Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium response data.
upstream: origin server response data
parameters.help_zh:
查询数据的来源。取值：
gf：表示高防响应数据。
upstream：表示源站响应数据
parameters.name: query_type
